name: Nandi Infrastructure Corridor Enterprises Limited
summary: The private company behind the Bangalore–Mysore Infrastructure Corridor and the toll expressway ring around south-west Bengaluru.
about: NICE holds the concession for the Bangalore–Mysore Infrastructure Corridor, a project agreed with the Karnataka government in the 1990s to build a tolled expressway between the two cities along with link and peripheral roads. The peripheral stretch through south-west Bengaluru was built and opened, and is heavily used; the full corridor to Mysore has been tangled in land disputes and litigation for years and remains incomplete.
facts: Holds the concession for the Bangalore–Mysore Infrastructure Corridor.
Its peripheral road through south-west Bengaluru is open and tolled.
The full corridor to Mysore has been delayed for years by land disputes and court cases.
